# Typora Mermaid Corpus

`typora-mermaid-corpus.md` 是 Mellow Mermaid 兼容性回归语料，覆盖：

- flowchart
- sequenceDiagram
- classDiagram
- stateDiagram-v2
- erDiagram
- pie
- mindmap
- timeline
- kanban
- error state

验收原则：Mermaid 11.x compatible；render lazy/debounced/cancellable/viewport-aware；caret inside reveals source；支持 copy source 与 export SVG。
